comparison.objective: Candidate mechanically removes four HELICOIL tangs; record performs iodine titration to a visually detected endpoint.
comparison.physical_skill: Candidate requires coaxial impact tooling and fragment pickup; record requires squeezing a burette clip, swirling a flask, observing color, and stopping irreversible dosing.
comparison.success_condition: Candidate requires four fractures and recovered fragments without damage; record requires stopping at the first lasting blue-black endpoint without overdosing.
comparison.reason: Closed-loop visual liquid dosing is unrelated to impact fracture and debris recovery.
